title: Storm of Iron
author: graham-mcneill
description: Warsmith Honsou of the Iron Warriors leads an assault on the Hydra Cordatus citadel — an Imperial fortress defended by tenacious Guardsmen and a handful of Imperial Fists. What unfolds is a merciless siege in the grand tradition of the Iron Warriors: methodical, attritional, and utterly without mercy.

title: Iron Warriors: The Omnibus
author: graham-mcneill
description: An omnibus collecting Iron Warriors short fiction and novellas — including the novel The Iron Warriors, the novella Iron Warrior, and multiple short stories chronicling Honsou's warband across decades of raids, betrayals and sieges. A definitive portrait of Perturabo's sons in the post-Heresy era.
